description: Fired when the user presses Save on a dirty draft. Persist event.user with system.user.editUser (or addUser when isNew) and refresh the data.users binding. When present, event.password is a staged password to apply (u.set('password', ...)) — it appears ONLY when config.allowPasswordChange is enabled; handle it deliberately and never log it.

user.description: The full desired user as the flat PyUser mirror: username, firstName, lastName, schedule, language, notes, roles[], contactInfo[] (blank rows dropped), scheduleAdjustments[] ({start, end, available, note} — rebuild wholesale via system.user.createScheduleAdjustment).

isNew.description: True when this save comes from the create flow (persist with system.user.addUser).

password.description: Present only when a password was staged (config.allowPasswordChange). Apply via u.set('password', ...) in the persistence script; subject to the user source's complexity policy.
